author: Axiom III
title: Export: Recovery Decay Panel for Dashboard v1 (Zephyr IV)
abstract: Exports recovery decay series and simple gating recommendation to dashboard/recovery_decay_zephyr_iv.json using derived analyzer output.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from meta.sas.tools.export_recovery_decay_panel import export_panel

out = export_panel(
    in_path='storage/shared/meta/sas/derived/recovery_decay_cps_v2_zephyr_iv.json',
    out_path='storage/shared/meta/sas/dashboard/recovery_decay_zephyr_iv.json'
)
print(json.dumps(out, indent=2))
